verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes its own rendered OpenAPI 3.0 reference at api.secureframe.com/docs. It covers the REST API with endpoint groups, request/response schemas, and versioning guidance, so there is an explorable reference. Nothing in the evidence shows runnable examples (no try-it console, no executable sample requests), so only half the story is delivered. missing for 10: documented runnable/try-it-out examples or an in-browser request console, code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference's interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The reference opens every tagged endpoint group with request/response schemas.
the document embeds the full "openapi: 3.0.0 / info: title: Secureframe API" OpenAPI definition that the renderer consumes
